execution_authority.migration_reason: Routine GitHub-hosted Actions previously generated excessive workflow usage and triggered a quota/usage warning email; RealSaS therefore moved routine scientific/mainline execution to the user's local self-hosted runner.
execution_authority.workflow_budget_policy: Do not fan out authority-map or routine science workflows across every experimental branch push. Prefer main authority changes, branch create/delete events, explicit manual dispatch, or already-required self-hosted scientific jobs.
execution_authority.rule: Scientific/mainline Actions execution authority is the user's local self-hosted RealSaS runner. A GitHub-hosted runner attempt is apparatus/config evidence only and cannot be interpreted as model-science evidence.

classes.CANONICAL: Only branch allowed to carry continuation authority.
classes.ACTIVE_EXPERIMENT: Explicitly registered live experiment branch. Never continuation authority by itself.
classes.EVIDENCE_ONLY: Explicit historical/research lineage retained for provenance.
classes.EVIDENCE_ONLY_UNREGISTERED: Observed non-main branch with no active registration. Safe default: never continuation authority.
classes.DELETE_CANDIDATE: Looks disposable by explicit naming rule. Do not delete automatically; review provenance first.
